title: Randomized polynomial time under P equals BPP
statement: Assume that the class of languages decidable by bounded-error randomized polynomial-time machines equals the class decidable by deterministic polynomial-time machines. Then the bounded-error randomized polynomial-time class is a proper subset of the languages decidable in time $n^{\log_2 n}$.
hypotheses_covered: Equality of the bounded-error randomized polynomial-time class and deterministic polynomial-time class
